died.name: Charles de Saint-Évremond
died.cause: when a clergyman asked if he would be reconciled
died.last_words: With all my heart: I would fain be reconciled to my stomach, which no longer performs its usual functions.

died.name: Paul-Thérèse-David d'Astros
died.desc: French Roman Catholic cardinal and archbishop
died.last_words: Neither life nor death, nor any being can separate us from Him.

died.name: Émile Zola
died.cause: dying of carbon monoxide poisoning from an improperly ventilated chimney
died.last_words: I feel sick. The dog is sick, too. We are both ill. It must be something we have eaten.

died.name: Milo Lemert
died.desc: United States Army soldier and recipient of the Medal of Honor
died.cause: mortally wounded near Bellicourt, France, during World War I
died.last_words: I'm all finished. Give them hell.

died.name: Matangini Hazra
died.cause: repeatedly chanting words from protest song while being shot by British Indian police at the age of 72

born.name: Pompey
born.cause: to Lucius Septimius, one of his assassins
born.last_words: Surely I am not mistaken, and you are an old comrade of mine!

born.name: Michael Servetus
born.cause: while being burned at the stake for heresy on a pyre of his own books
born.last_words: Jesus, Son of the eternal God, have mercy on me!

born.name: Miguel de Cervantes
born.last_words: Already my foot is in the stirrup.

born.name: William Russell, Lord Russell
born.cause: after bidding farewell to his wife prior to execution by beheading for treason
born.last_words: Now the bitterness of death is past.

born.name: Horatio Nelson, 1st Viscount Nelson
born.cause: mortally wounded at the Battle of Trafalgar
born.last_words: Thank God, I have done my duty.

born.name: Ernest M. McSorley
born.desc: Canadian sailor and captain of SS Edmund Fitzgerald
born.cause: last transmission before ship went down in storm on Lake Superior

born.name: Arthur Gary Bishop
born.desc: American convicted sex offender and serial killer
born.cause: prior to execution by lethal injection
born.last_words: I want to offer again my most profound and heartfelt apologies to my victims' families. I am truly sorry. I have tried my best to empathize with their grief and devastation and I hope they come to know of my concerns and prayers for them.
